observations: Photo shows a single PS4 'Fat' style console (white top, black bottom) wrapped in plastic film.
A small sticker/label is visible on the top edge but text is unreadable.
No controllers, cables, games, or receipt are visible in the photo.
No visible ports or rear panel to confirm 'all ports working'.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows console but no origin marking or label readable.
No accessories, controllers, or discs visible in photo 0.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Cannot inspect internal seals or screws from a single external photo.
Requires power-on test or video demonstration, not shown.
No receipt image provided; also seems inconsistent with 'Japan used' claim.

risks.risk: Accessories (pads, games, cables) may not be included despite claim.
risks.proof: A photo showing all items laid out together with the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, no accessories

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may overheat.
risks.proof: A video clip of the console powering on and running a game for a few minutes.

risks.risk: Origin claim (Japan vs UK receipt) inconsistency could indicate misrepresentation.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the receipt and any import/region markings on the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified origin, no premium applied

risks.risk: Hidden damage or repair under the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Photo with wrap removed showing full casing and ports.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and running a disc game.
Photo of all included accessories (pads, cables, games) together with the console.
Clear photo of the UK receipt and any visible serial/region sticker.
Close-up of the rear port panel showing no corrosion or damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly a PS4 Fat-style console, but none of the seller's claims about accessories, working condition, or origin are verifiable from the single photo, so it must be priced at the worst case as a bare, unverified console matching the cheapest comparable fat/big PS4 listings.
